answer: Since the relic audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the bridge beacon after the epoch ends and the karst nonce differs from the first. Each close, 33% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward.
